Built from **Stump 0.1.9** — everything that release has, plus what this fork adds.

### From Stump 0.1.8 / 0.1.9
- One-shot libraries: a configurable folder whose books each become their own series
- Home-page section preferences (reorder or hide the sections)
- Layered configuration system, reorganised core crate, faster web bundle (chunking + lazy loading)
- Authorization fixes for the four issues this fork reported: privileged account fields, the
  library missing-files listing, previous book-club discussions, and the metadata overview.
  They now come from upstream, with their own integration tests

### Fork changes in this release
- **Upgrading can no longer brick a server.** Stump 0.1.9 removed the `profile` setting and its
  loader rejects unknown keys, so an existing `Stump.toml` stopped the server from starting.
  Settings a build no longer knows are ignored with a warning instead
- Web: localization restored on the rewritten server stats, jobs table and metadata table; the
  translation-contribution notice no longer draws its buttons over the text; book descriptions
  that arrive as indented HTML are rendered instead of being printed as a code block

Full list of fork features: [What this fork adds](https://github.com/vint1024/NoirPanther#what-this-fork-adds)
